## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_正财 (Wood carrying The Steward). Persona The Steward (正财). Definition line: "Methodical, directed acquisition, the value built and kept". Keyword Caution, charge gentle, poles catalyst Security / friction Hoarding. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: value built and kept; counting what others spend freely. Arena: granary, kept things, stone by stone, seasons of saving. Classical portrait: methodical, directed acquisition; value built and kept; caution, thrift, the slow ledger. Ruled domains: Wealth, Savings, Steady love. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏财.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal directing Wood cross-polarity — precision shaping reach toward structured outcomes".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Steward: growth banked in rings. You build worth the way orchards do, planted early, tended patiently, harvested honestly, replanted always. Assets in your care grow. So do people. Your fortune is cumulative and alive, and it rewards the seasons you refuse to rush."
- k2_functional: "You build annually: steady deposits of effort that quietly become an estate."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Stuck","Plays it safe","Inflexible"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Wealth":"Your wealth is orchard-shaped: productive assets, patient growth, income in seasons. You like what grows on its own, a skill, a plot, a stake left alone, and you let time do the heaviest lifting. It intends to.","Savings":"You save like a granary: harvests stored against winters. Rotate the stock, reinvest the surplus, and remember granaries exist so that planting can be brave.","Steady love":"You love agriculturally: devotion planted deep, tended daily, expected to fruit for decades. Choose a fellow gardener. Then keep courting through every season, even the mud ones."}

- Sibling cell 木_偏财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your effort naturally runs in several directions at once, and the directions feed each other more than they collide. Focus, as commonly preached, never fit you: your luck lives in the overlaps, where one venture waters the next. So you stopped apologizing for the branching."

Core element Metal, energy element Wood. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Wood is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Wood on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Wood as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. value.text: Building slowly is where you feel most sure of yourself. You have more push than Wood to put it into, so you spend years on one thing rather than chase quick results on several. Let it take the time it takes, because the slow build is the one you keep.

value_b.text: What you make, you make to last, and you are in no hurry. Since you want things to last more than to arrive first, you add to one thing for years ahead of trying a new one. Keep adding to it and let someone see it half built, because the years are the price.

value.text: Your way of providing is to build something that lasts decades. Since you put finished ahead of shared, you keep the people near you waiting on a payoff instead of handing over the half-done thing. Hand it over half done once, because waiting on the finished one is what your care costs them.

value.text: Putting money aside comes before spending it, and you never have to decide that. Being covered means more to you than anything you would buy, so the saving comes ahead of the wanting every month. Keep the habit and spend one small part on yourself, because a cushion is also for sitting on.

value_b.text: You save first and spend what is left, and the order has never felt like a sacrifice. Since knowing you are covered matters more than most things you would buy, you put money away ahead of pleasure every time. Let pleasure win once in a while, because that is also what the cover is for.

value.text: Being counted on comes ahead of being exciting for you. Since being known for years feels safer than being wanted for a week, you show up the same on dull days as on good ones. Let yourself be surprising once a year, because staying is the gift and sameness is its price.

value_b.text: You stay, and you count the staying as the love itself. Since being someone's certainty feels better to you than being their surprise, you keep showing up ahead of ever showing off. Show off for the person you stay with from time to time, because you were chosen for more than the staying.

value.text: Where you have given your word, you stay, long after the reasons have changed. Since keeping feels more like love than choosing does, you stop asking whether this is what you want or only what you promised. Ask yourself every year or so, because you deserve to be chosen by you as well.

value.text: Staying is how you love, and you give it instead of saying it. Since showing up counts for more with you than speaking up, you hand the people you keep your presence ahead of your feelings. Tell them once in plain words, because your silence makes the person who stays do the guessing.
